title: Engineer Who Can Design - Americas
description:
Hi I’m Abhik, Ashby's Co-Founder and VP of Engineering. As someone who could design and build software, this position is close to my heart. I always felt I had a unique perspective because I could play with design ideas and iterate in code. My ideas could start in Figma but then be grounded (or sometimes more creative) in code. My prototypes used actual logic and data. My changes cascaded throughout the app for comprehensive critique (thanks, React component system!). But, every company made me pick one —I couldn’t design and build. At Ashby, you can.

While every engineer can design and build, you’ll tackle our most challenging design problems and help others improve their designs by expanding and enhancing our in‑house design system and consulting on bespoke work. To ground it with examples, engineers who can design at Ashby have:

  • Redesigned our mobile web app by talking with customers who use it often, wireframing new flows, implementing its design system, and using it to make the wireframes a reality.
  • Built a set of flexible, composable components in our design system that allow other engineers to build custom autocompletes. These autocompletes can contain filters, options to create new records, etc.
  • Helped another engineer improve their design’s information hierarchy and scannability for viewing a candidate’s assessments. Recruiters can quickly parse information and pick out anomalies.

These projects reflect what we’re accomplishing at Ashby: improving the productivity of working professionals (starting with talent teams) with intelligent and powerful software. We put a lot of effort into designing products that are approachable to beginners but mastered & extended by power users. In many ways, spreadsheets set the bar here.

We have many customers, great revenue growth, years of runway, and amazing investors like YCombinator, Elad Gil, and Lachy Groom. I’ll share more once we meet.

This is a staff‑level role, so we require at least 5 years of experience as a full‑time frontend engineer or evenly split between frontend and design for this role and significant contributions to (or leading) design systems.

Engineering Culture

Our engineering culture is motivated by Benji’s (my co‑founder and CEO) and my belief that a small talented team, given the right environment, can build high‑quality software fast (and work regular hours!).

Collaboration is Natural & Communication is Deliberate

Our engineering team (and the team at large) consists of lifelong learners who are humble and kind (meet them here!). These attributes create an environment where collaboration happens naturally (we filter for it in interviews). We combine this with research, prototyping, and written proposals to see around corners and get feedback from the team across time zones. Focus time is something that we hold sacred, and, with thoughtful and deliberate communication, engineers spend less than 4 hours per week in meetings (I wrote about it here).

Increase Leverage, not Team Size

We built Ashby with the quality, breadth, and depth that many customers would expect from much larger teams over larger time scales. We’ve done this through investment in:

  • Great developer tooling. Our CI/CD takes ~10m, and we deploy at least 10x a day. Everyone on the team has contributed to developer experience.
  • Building blocks to create powerful and customizable products fast. At the core of Ashby is a set of common components (analytics modeling and query language, policy engine, workflow engine, design system) which we are constantly improving. Each improvement to a common component cascades throughout our app (short video below).

Here’s an impromptu quote from Arjun in our company Slack of what it’s like to build a feature at Ashby:

And a demo of one of these building blocks:

Give Engineers Ownership & Autonomy

We, as engineers, find clever ways to solve problems, which amplifies when we deeply understand the problem. Benji and I did our best work as engineers when we had a deep understanding of the end‑user and the business and ownership over the solution. Our engineering culture reflects this experience: engineers own projects end‑to‑end, from speaking with users to writing product specs to UX design. These are skills that we often don’t get to practice as engineers, and, at Ashby, we provide mentorship to grow them and help from the team where you want it.

Put Effort into Diversity

Diverse teams drive innovation and better outcomes. Having seen my mother and partner build their careers as minority women in non‑diverse fields, I want to make sure Ashby creates opportunities for the next generation of engineers from underrepresented groups (including my daughter!).

Today, 26% of engineers at Ashby are from underrepresented groups. It’s not great, and we are taking conscious steps to improve, like sourcing diverse candidates, providing generous paid family leave, no leetcode interviews, and more.

Interview Process

At Ashby, our team and interview process want to help you show your best self. We’ll dive into past projects and simulate working together via pair programming, writing tech specs collaboratively, and talking through decisions (no leetcode or whiteboard exercises). Our interview process is three rounds with some casual Zoom (or in‑person) coffee in between to get to know each other:

  • 30‑minute introduction call to discuss Ashby and your past work (we demo Ashby!)
  • A technical screen (take home or, for more experienced folks who want it, a 90‑minute live session)
  • A virtual on‑site of 3 hours and 45 minutes (can be split across two days)

Your hiring manager will be your main point of contact and prepare you for interviews. You’ll meet other engineering leaders and 4 to 6 engineers (with 15 minutes in each interview to ask them questions). If we don’t give an offer, we’ll provide feedback!

Your First Two Months at Ashby

We want an exceptional onboarding experience for every new hire. At Ashby, your dev environment sets up with a single script, you push your first change on day one, and we spend the rest of the time building your confidence in our codebase and practices culminating in delivering a prominent, impactful feature. We’ll pair you with a peer who’ll guide you through your first tasks and be someone you rely on, from answering questions to pair programming.

Technology Stack

Our tech stack is TypeScript (frontend & backend), React, a mix of SASS modules and Stitches, Apollo GraphQL, Node.js, Postgres, and Redis. We’re looking for folks with deep React, CSS, and HTML knowledge for this role.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity.
  • 10‑year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby —do it when you feel financially comfortable.
  • Unlimited PTO with four weeks recommended per year. Expect “Vacation?” in our one‑on‑one agenda until you start taking it.
  • Twelve weeks of fully paid family leave in the US. We plan to expand this to employees in other countries as situations arise.
  • Generous equipment, software, and office furniture budget. Get what you need to be happy and productive!
  • $100/month education budget with more expensive items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.
  • If you’re in the US, top‑notch health insurance for you and your dependents with all premiums covered by us.

Ashby’s success hinges on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We’re being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Buscamos soluções digitais que conectem clubes, federações, ligas e marcas ao público de forma eficaz e inovadora. Na vaga de suporte de TI, sua missão será garantir que tudo funcione e evolua. Você será o guardião da estabilidade e da inovação por trás dos sistemas que mantêm a Live Mode funcionando, conectando tecnologia, pessoas e inteligência artificial. Cada servidor otimizado, cada automação criada e cada rede segura ajudam a impulsionar não só nossa operação, mas também a maneira como o esporte é transmitido e vivido globalmente.

Responsabilidades

  • Manutenção e monitoramento da infraestrutura local: acompanhar o funcionamento dos equipamentos e sistemas internos, garantindo estabilidade, desempenho e disponibilidade dos serviços de TI.
  • Administração de redes: auxiliar na configuração e manutenção de redes LAN, Wi‑Fi, VPN, firewall, roteadores e switches, assegurando conectividade e segurança para os usuários.
  • Suporte técnico de N2 ou N3: atender e solucionar chamados e incidentes de usuários internos, oferecendo suporte técnico ágil e eficaz para diferentes áreas da empresa.
  • Gestão de ativos e inventário: manter atualizado o controle de hardware, licenças e equipamentos de TI, assegurando rastreabilidade e conformidade.
  • Apoio à segurança da informação: colaborar na implantação e manutenção de políticas e boas práticas de segurança, reforçando a proteção dos dados e sistemas corporativos.
  • Documentação técnica: criar e atualizar procedimentos, manuais e bases de conhecimento, facilitando a consulta e o compartilhamento interno de informações técnicas.
  • Integração com ferramentas de monitoramento: utilizar e manter sistemas de observabilidade como Zabbix e Grafana para acompanhar o desempenho da infraestrutura.
  • Apoio a projetos de infraestrutura: participar de iniciativas de migração, atualização e expansão de sistemas corporativos, contribuindo com suporte técnico e execução operacional.

Requisitos necessários

  • Conhecimentos em infraestrutura e redes: entendimento básico de protocolos TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, VPN, VLANs, roteamento e balanceamento de rede.
  • Firewall e segurança: familiaridade com ferramentas como Fortigate ou Mikrotik para controle e proteção do tráfego de rede.
  • Sistemas operacionais: noções de administração em Windows Server e Linux (Ubuntu).
  • Cloud e virtualização: conhecimento introdutório em plataformas como Proxmox, VMware ou Hyper‑V.
  • Monitoramento: uso de ferramentas como Zabbix, Grafana ou PRTG para acompanhar indicadores de desempenho.
  • Suporte ao usuário: experiência com Active Directory, Office 365 e GSuite, além de gestão de acessos e dispositivos.
  • Exploração ativa de IA e automações: interesse e prática comprovada com ferramentas de IA generativa (ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, automações via IA etc.), demonstrando uso no dia a dia acadêmico ou pessoal.

  • Plano Odontológico (Mais DOC) sem custo mensal para o colaborador para o plano "Mais Doc", com possibilidade de migração para outros planos (diferença de valor descontada em folha) e inclusão de dependentes (cônjuge e filhos), com desconto em folha.

  • Auxílio para Dependentes PCD para colaboradores que apoiam pessoas com deficiência, mediante apresentação de laudo médico.

  • Open English oferece acesso a cursos de inglês ou espanhol em diversos formatos, com descontos exclusivos para colaboradores e familiares.

Nossa cultura

Na LiveMode, nossa missão é Transformar e Crescer o Esporte , e nossos valores são o combustível que nos move no dia a dia. Acreditamos que crescer exige inconformismo, ambição e consistência. Nossa cultura nasce disso: de gente que não aceita o que está aí, que quer fazer mais, aprender mais e entregar mais — sempre com responsabilidade e visão de futuro. Quem está na LiveMode está aqui para marcar a história do esporte no Brasil e no Mundo.

SOMOS EMPREENDEDORES

Ontem, hoje e sempre escolhemos o gol e corremos atrás dele com tudo. Focamos em poucas prioridades e vamos até o fim, sem distrações. Tratamos cada recurso como se fosse nosso, decidindo rápido e com coragem. Comunicação? Direta, aberta e na velocidade do jogo.

SOMOS UM TIME DE ALTA PERFORMANCE

Não uma família ou uma confraria de amigos. Família a gente não escolhe, mas o time escolhe quem joga. E quando o jogo é grande, não dá pra carregar quem não está entregando. Aqui, a gente decide pelo que é melhor para a empresa, não pra uma área ou pessoa. Toda entrega tem um dono claro, que vai até o fim. Processos ajudam, mas não mandam: quem resolve são as pessoas.

SOMOS AMBICIOSOS

Pensamos sempre grande. A gente já fez muita coisa grande. Mas quem está na LiveMode sabe que dá pra ir além. Porque quem é ambicioso de verdade vive com a sensação de que sempre dá pra melhorar, crescer, fazer mais impacto. Aqui, a ambição não é discurso. É prática. E é ela que nos leva a quebrar recorde atrás de recorde.

O QUE NOS MOVE É O FUTURO

Na LiveMode, o futuro já está em movimento — e quem não acompanha, fica pra trás. Por isso, tratamos tecnologia com urgência: testamos, aprendemos e aplicamos com velocidade. Queremos ser uma empresa IA first, porque acreditamos que dominar essas ferramentas não é opcional — é o que vai nos ajudar a alcançar nossa missão mais rápido. IA não é extra. É parte central do nosso dia a dia.

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. Most of Carta’s long‑term success will come from products and technology that have yet to be built. Here is an incomplete list of how you might contribute:

  • Building customer‑facing enterprise tools for equity administration
  • Creating data pipelines for asynchronously aggregating financial reports
  • Reinforcing service resiliency, availability, and fault tolerance
  • Streamlining the creation of new features and services within our ecosystem
  • Integrating with third‑party vendors to provide reliable, accurate, and timely transfers of billions of dollars per year through Carta's platform
  • Refactoring existing features into standalone event‑driven services
  • And others for you to discover and champion

You’ll work directly with internal and external stakeholders to ensure we’re building the right thing at the right time with the right people. Your contributions will enable Carta's mission to make equity more available and accessible to everyone.

The Team You’ll Work With

This role sits on our Data Integrations team, building the necessary network infrastructure for the flow of financial and HRIS (Human Resources Information Systems) data into and out of Carta, powering the entire company management experience.

You will join our engineering team of passionate learners, builders, experts, and leaders to define and implement Carta's next generation of products, platforms, and infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with key stakeholders in Product, Business, and Design. Carta's software engineers contribute in many different ways: sometimes we are shipping new product features, architecting simple and maintainable systems, or training the organization on new technology solutions. You will make your own mark here.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross‑functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer.
  • You have strong technical skills and are an excellent collaborator.
  • You implement systems that are clear, maintainable, and correct.
  • You are excited by opportunities to both break ground on new projects and provide fresh perspective onto past implementations.
  • You want to build and own your work end‑to‑end.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
  • You have full stack experience, specifically with Typescript and any backend language.
  • You may be familiar with some additional elements of the Carta tech stack (Python, Django, React, Postgres, gRPC, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS).

The Interview Process

First, one of our recruiters will call you to tell you more about the job and company. You'll then meet an Engineering leader who will discuss your opportunities at Carta and explore your experience, skills, and goals. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list). Finally, you'll have back‑to‑back conversations with Carta team members on a wide range of topics, including communications and collaboration, coding efficacy and techniques, and systems design.

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.
  • Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.
  • Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

title: Senior Software Engineer I, Integrations
description:
The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow. Most of Carta's long‑term success will come from products and technology that have yet to be built. Here is an incomplete list of how you might contribute:

  • Building customer‑facing enterprise tools for equity administration
  • Creating data pipelines for asynchronously aggregating financial reports
  • Reinforcing service resiliency, availability, and fault tolerance
  • Streamlining the creation of new features and services within our ecosystem
  • Integrating with third‑party vendors to provide reliable, accurate, and timely transfers of billions of dollars per year through Carta's platform
  • Refactoring existing features into standalone event‑driven services
  • And others for you to discover and champion

You’ll work directly with internal and external stakeholders to ensure we’re building the right thing at the right time with the right people. Your contributions will enable Carta's mission to make equity more available and accessible to everyone.

The Team You’ll Work With

This role sits on our Data Integrations team, building the necessary network infrastructure for the flow of financial and HRIS (Human Resources Information Systems) data into and out of Carta, powering the entire company management experience.

You will join our engineering team of passionate learners, builders, experts, and leaders to define and implement Carta's next generation of products, platforms, and infrastructure. You'll collaborate closely with key stakeholders in Product, Business, and Design. Carta's software engineers contribute in many different ways: sometimes we are shipping new product features, architecting simple and maintainable systems, or training the organization on new technology solutions. You will make your own mark here.

About You

At Carta, you’re not just an employee. You’re a builder who is creating infrastructure that accelerates innovation and empowers more ownership. Cartans are helpful, relentless, unconventional and kind; representing Carta’s Identity Traits. They work collaboratively and cross‑functionally to challenge the status quo; working towards a common goal of creating more owners in the private markets.

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer.
  • You have strong technical skills and are an excellent collaborator.
  • You implement systems that are clear, maintainable, and correct.
  • You are excited by opportunities to both break ground on new projects and provide fresh perspective onto past implementations.
  • You want to build and own your work end‑to‑end
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
  • You have full stack experience, specifically with Typescript and any backend language
  • You may be familiar with some additional elements of the Carta tech stack (Python, Django, React, Postgres, GRPC, Kafka, docker, K8, AWS)

The Interview Process

First, one of our recruiters will call you to tell you more about the job and company. You'll then meet an Engineering leader who will discuss your opportunities at Carta and explore your experience, skills, and goals. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list). Finally, you'll have back‑to‑back conversations with Carta team members on a wide range of topics, including communications and collaboration, coding efficacy and techniques, and systems design.

Join us at Better Cotton as Membership & Supply Chain Officer, LATAM & Portugal and support member engagement and the implementation of Better Cotton’s supply chain systems across the LATAM and Portugal region.

Reporting & Administration

Essential

Working Arrangements

The position is full‑time (40 hours per week), offers flexible working arrangements, and will be based remotely in Brazil. The role will be hired through an employer of record acting on behalf of Better Cotton. The role requires occasional travel to meet the team and some stakeholders (up to 15%).

Apply Now

Better Cotton does not use artificial intelligence or automated screening tools in its hiring process. Every application is reviewed by our People & Culture team and relevant hiring managers to ensure a fair and human‑led assessment experience.

Our Hiring Process

Initial Screening

Applicant screening is a crucial step in our recruitment process. This stage may involve a brief phone interview or video call to evaluate your suitability for the position. During this screening, we review resumes and cover letters, and may conduct initial background checks to narrow down the pool of applicants. Internal candidates are encouraged to inform their line manager about their application to promote transparency and help facilitate a smooth transition if selected.

Interviews

If you successfully pass the initial screening, you will be invited for interviews. The interview process at Better Cotton may include one or more rounds of interviews with various stakeholders, such as the hiring manager, team members, and potentially senior management.

Assessment And Testing

Depending on the role, you might be required to complete assessments, technical tests, or skills evaluations to gauge your competency and suitability for the position.

Reference Checks

Once you progress further in the process, reference checks are conducted to validate your work history, skills, and qualifications.

Offer Stage

After completing interviews, assessments, and reference checks, the hiring team evaluates your performance and fit for the role. If selected, you will receive a formal job offer letter outlining the terms of employment, compensation, benefits, and any other relevant details.

Better Cotton is a global not‑for‑profit organisation supporting the production of more equitable and sustainable cotton at farm level. We exist to catalyse the cotton farming community with partners, governments, and others to continuously drive positive impact by setting standards and facilitating the supply and demand of more sustainable cotton from farm to brand.

Being you @ Better Cotton

Better Cotton is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal‑opportunity employer with a strong commitment to good practice and transparency in the management of natural, human, and financial resources. We have a zero‑tolerance approach to any attitudes or behaviours that put children or adults at risk of harm. You will collaborate with product managers, designers, and backend engineers to create responsive, intuitive interfaces that streamline clinical workflows and enable doctors to focus on what truly matters—patient care.

  • Integrate with RESTful APIs and manage data flow efficiently.

  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.

Benefits & Perks

title: PESSOA TÉCNICO DE ENFERMAGEM HEMODIN MICA / HOSPITAL CASA PREMIUM - RJ/CLT
description:
Visão da Empresa

Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores.

Resumo da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como TÉCNICO DE ENFERMAGEM HEMODINÂMICA que seja proativo, cuidadoso, dedicado e que tenha atenção e amor pelos seus processos de trabalho.

Suas principais atividades serão:

  1. Participar de dar continuidade às atividades determinadas pela gerência e coordenação de enfermagem.
  2. Exercer a função assistencial, educativa, de pesquisa e social, em concordância com a Gerência de Enfermagem.
  3. Auxiliar na identificação dos fatores que favorecem e dificultam o processo de enfermagem.
  4. Zelar pelas condições ambientais de segurança do setor, buscando o bem‑estar da equipe interdisciplina.
  5. Solucionar as intercorrências, visando um bom padrão de assistência ao cliente.
  6. Prestar assistência aos pacientes, atendendo suas necessidades básicas (higiene e conforto, apoio emocional), zelando pela sua segurança.
  7. Participar de Reuniões com a gerência, supervisão ou Coordenação de Enfermagem, quando solicitado.
  8. Participar da passagem de plantão dentro da sala operatória, checando organização da mesma, conferindo materiais, incluindo equipamentos necessários, ap (an) ate anestésico-cirúrgico e materiais que necessitam de data em dia.
  9. Fazer cumprir as normas e rotinas já existentes, incluindo CCIH de acordo com os Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POP).
  10. Ser assíduo, pontual e disciplinado.
  11. Manter chefia direta informada sobre as intercorrências do serviço, solicitando da mesma, quando necessário, as devidas providências.
  12. Responsabilizar‑se por todos os materiais do setor, zelando pelo uso adequado.
  13. Comunicar ao Enfermeiro supervisor qualquer defeito ou anormalidades ocorridos com matérias e equipamentos em sala.
  14. Preencher diariamente o mapa de controle de temperatura da sala de cirurgia.
  15. Avaliar diariamente a necessidade de material permanente (Braçadeira de pressão não invasiva PNI, cabo de oxímetro, etc.) e comunicar à sua chefia imediata para reposição.
  16. Avaliar diariamente a necessidade de material descartável para consumo (campos de cobertura cirúrgica, campos de mesa auxiliar).
  17. Realizar diariamente a reposição dos impressos de sala cirúrgica.
  18. Usar adequadamente os equipamentos de proteção individual (EPI), de acordo com ambiente e/ou tipo de material utilizado e norma regulamentadora NR32.
  19. Preencher diariamente no primeiro horário do plantão o check list da sala de cirurgia, repondo os materiais faltantes.
  20. Estar ciente quanto aos procedimentos que serão realizados na sala de hemodinâmica sob sua responsabilidade.

Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Nível Médio completo.
  • Curso técnico em enfermagem completo.
  • Experiência de 6 meses na função.
  • CONHECIMENTO EM PROCEDIMENTOS ESPECÍFICOS DE HEMODINÂMICA, CARDIOLOGIA.
  • Coren ativo.
  • Pacote office.

Conheça os benefícios que oferecemos para você:

  • Vale Transporte.
  • Refeição no local.
  • Convênio Médico.
  • Convênio Odontológico.

Horário de trabalho

Escala 12x36.

Posição Aberta

Possui todos os requisitos e se identifica? Venha fazer parte da nossa casa!

Background

The technician is also responsible for ensuring that his supervisor is made aware of all activities according to procedure, especially when safety is an issue.

Authority

  • The Production Technician is authorized to operate the process and utility systems safely and efficiently and help to prepare such plant for maintenance.

  • 9 Prove export oil meters.
  • 2) Marine/Safety
  • 1 Work as directed by Management System policies and procedures in particular Isolation Standards, and PTW.
  • 2 Carry out all operations in safe and environmentally sound manner.
  • 3 Report all discharges, leaks, spills, injuries, and incidents, immediately.
  • 4 Ensure vendor and subcontract personnel within responsibility understand and comply with current environmental regulations.
  • 5 Carry out Emergency Response role.

  • 1 Facilitate maintenance operations by applying/removing isolations as required.

  • 5 Maintain clear and precise communications during maintenance operations.

  • 1 Carry Out Emergency Response role.

Overview

Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores.

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como TÉCNICO DE ENFERMAGEM HEMODINÂMICA que seja proativo, cuidadoso, dedicado e que tenha uma atenção e amor com seus processos de trabalho.

Principais atividades

  1. Participar de dar continuidade às atividades determinadas pela gerencia e coordenação de enfermagem
  2. Exercer a função assistencial, educativa, de pesquisa e social, em concordância com a Gerência de enfermagem
  3. Auxiliar na identificação dos fatores que que favorecem e dificultam o processo de enfermagem
  4. Zelar pelas condições ambientais nde segurança do setor, buscando o bem estar da equipe interdiscilinar
  5. Solucionar as intercorrências , visando um bom padrão de assistência ao cliente.
  6. Prestar assistência aos pacientes, atendendo suas necessidades básicas (higiene e conforto, apoio emocional), zelando pela sua segurança.
  7. Participar de Reuniões com a gerencia, supervisão ou Coordenação de enfermagem, quando solicitado.
  8. Participar da passagem de plantão dentro da sala operatória, checando organização da mesma, conferindo materiais, incluindo equipamentos necessários, ap ato anestésico-cirúrgico e materias que necessitam de data em dia.
  9. Fazer cumprir as normas e rotinas já existentes , incluindo CCIH de acordo com os Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (POP)
  10. Ser assíduo, pontual e disciplinado
  11. Manter chefia direta informada sobre as intercorrências do serviço, solicitando da mesma , quando necessário, as devidas providências.
  12. Responsabilizar-se por todos os materiais do setor, zelando pelo uso adequadamente.
  13. Comunicar ao Enfermeiro supervisor qualquer defeito ou anormalidades ocorridos com materias e equipamentos em sala.
  14. Preencher diariamente o mapa de controle de temperatura da sala de cirurgia.
  15. Avaliar diariamente a necessidade de material permanente( Braçadeira de pressão Não invasiva ?PNI, cabo de oximetro etc) e comunicar à sua chefia imediata para reposição.
  16. Avaliar diariamente a necessidade de material descartavel para consumo (Campos de cobertura cirúrgica, campos de mesa auxiliar)
  17. Realizar diariamente a reposição dos impressos de sala cirúrgica
  18. Usar adequadamente os equipamentos de proteção individual (EPI?S), de acordo com ambiente e/ou tipo de material utilizado e norma regulamentadora NR32
  19. Preencher diariamente no primeiro horário do plantão o check list da sala de cirurgia, repondo os materiais faltantes
  20. Estar ciente quanto aos procedimentos que serão realizados na sala de hemodinâmica sob sua responsabilidade

Requisitos

  • Nível Médio completo;
  • Curso técnico em enfermagem completo;
  • Experiência de 6 meses na função;

description:
Senior Software Engineer I, Manage Company

The Company You’ll Join

Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world‑class software, purpose‑built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that – it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets – a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As we continue expanding beyond Venture Capital into Private Equity markets, we’re building solutions to address the unique challenges of clients managing companies and funds structured as LLCs. These entities vary widely in contractual structures and represent diverse asset classes, requiring a flexible and scalable data model that supports distinct product experiences. Additionally, Private Equity firms, their investors, legal partners, and portfolio companies interact with our platform through different user personas and permissions, making robust access control and tailored experiences essential.

As a Senior Engineer on this team, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the next generation of ownership management products. You’ll work closely with product, design, and go‑to‑market teams—as well as directly with top‑tier Private Equity firms and enterprise‑scale clients—to deeply understand their needs and deliver high‑quality technical solutions.

The Team You’ll Work With

You’ll be joining our Asset Management LLC Captable team. We launched the Carta LLC product in 2020 and, after discovering a repeatable go‑to‑market motion, have been on a journey to scale it across the entire portfolio of Private Equity companies. We’re also expanding to support a wide range of ownership management workflows.

The scope and impact of each individual on the team are immense. We are biased toward action and believe in the mantra: build → measure → learn. As part of our team, you'll work closely with product managers and designers to understand the motivation (why) behind a customer need, define the scope of work (what), and collaborate with your engineering peers to build solutions (how) that deliver meaningful customer value.

About You

You deeply care about your user and are relentless in your pursuit to build delightful user experiences that wow the customer! You are energized by solving deep problems collaboratively who can easily transition between a Solver and Tech Lead archetype.

  • You have 5+ years of full‑stack or backend engineering experience.
  • You are passionate about some elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, Java, Datadog, REST / GRPC, Kafka, K8s, AWS).
  • You are excited to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business and marketing.
  • You have a desire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous product requirements to deliver customer value.
  • You see communication as one of your strengths.
  • You want to build and own your work end‑to‑end.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.

The Interview Process

Carta follows a standard tech startup interview process, where you will meet with a recruiter and hiring manager first. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real‑world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode‑style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly‑linked list) and virtual interviews. During the process, you can ask questions to people across different parts of the Fund Administration team to learn what kind of work we do and how it lines up with your interests.

  • Mentorar e influenciar times técnicos.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • +5 anos em arquitetura de sistemas ou papel equivalente (Tech Lead/Staff/Sr. Eng.) em produtos de alta disponibilidade;
  • Experiência sólida com C#/.NET (Core/7/8) e SQL Server (otimização e tuning);
  • Vivência prática com containers (Docker/Kubernetes), microserviços e mensageria;
  • Experiência em cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP) com serviços gerenciados;
  • Definição de APIs (REST/GraphQL), autenticação/autorização (OAuth2/OIDC);
  • Conhecimentos em observabilidade (logs estruturados, métricas, tracing distribuído);
  • Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD e Infra as Code;
  • Diferenciais:
    • Event Sourcing, outbox pattern, gRPC e Service Mesh;
    • Cache distribuído (Redis), API Gateway (APIM/Kong/YARP);
    • NoSQL (MongoDB, Cosmos DB) e Elasticsearch;
    • Certificações relevantes (Azure Architect, AWS SA, CKA/CKAD).
  • Forte capacidade analítica e visão sistêmica;
  • Liderança técnica: mentoria, influência e facilitação de decisões;

description:
Senior Customer Success Analyst (Rio de Janeiro ou São Paulo)

Join to apply for the Senior Customer Success Analyst (Rio de Janeiro ou São Paulo) role at Equinix .

Who are we?

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet. A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future. A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.

Equinix is a global digital infrastructure company, operating more than 260 data centers worldwide. Digital leaders use Equinix’s reliable platform to connect and interconnect core infrastructure at the speed of software. Equinix enables organizations to access all the right places, partners and possibilities to scale with agility, accelerate the launch of digital services, deliver world‑class experiences and multiply their value, while supporting sustainability goals.

As a Senior Customer Success Analyst, you will strategically drive three core pillars to the business:

  • Relationship with Field Sales customers: provide direct support to strategic, large accounts, ensuring an excellent experience from first contact.
  • Support to sales with a focus on upselling: work side‑by‑side with the commercial team, identifying expansion opportunities and proposing solutions that align with customer needs.
  • Retention and customer loyalty: lead an effective onboarding and maintain continuous follow‑up, analyzing metrics, controlling churn and proactively preventing and resolving issues to ensure customer satisfaction and continued engagement.

Integration of Clients

Use judgment to tailor the best client interaction approach, considering their needs and the scope of the project. Follow the 3‑phase methodology:

  • Phase 1 – Pre‑integration: Perform preparatory activities with all clients.
  • Phase 2 – Initial meeting: Schedule, facilitate and conduct initial integration meetings.
  • Phase 3 – Continuous follow‑up: Establish a regular cadence of contact to monitor client evolution.

You may lead integrations across regions in partnership with other Customer Success Managers (CSMs). Translate internal processes clearly, align expectations and positively influence clients and stakeholders.

Relationship and Personalization

Interact with cross‑functional teams, collect detailed client information to personalize experiences and understand strategic direction. After onboarding, follow up on actions and tasks linked to client goals. Identify trends and ask strategic questions to deepen business understanding.

Adoption and Customer Success Management

Develop, maintain and monitor Customer Success Plans across scopes. Promote product and process adoption based on usage trends. Share product knowledge to empower clients. Collect and manage feedback, proposing continuous improvements based on client insights.

Strategic Collaboration

Collaborate with account teams in pre‑sales discussions, acting as a customer advocate. Ensure smooth transitions across internal areas. Lead special projects with cross‑functional teams, including global accounts. Implement best practices and maintain proactive client contact.

Issue and Escalation Management

Assess and prioritize issues and escalations, ensuring visibility and proper resolution. Work with stakeholders to enforce policies and procedures, communicating resolutions and improvement plans with clarity and empathy.

Account Retention

Partner with sales and management for account oversight. Support contractual obligations, proactively identify churn risks and contribute to retention strategies. Conduct regular operational reviews and manage follow‑up projects.

Main Requirements

  • Completed higher education.
  • Advanced English (interview in English).
  • Prior experience in Customer Success, Post‑sales, Technical Support or Consulting.
  • Experience handling a diverse, extensive B2B client portfolio.
  • Knowledge of customer success metrics (NPS, churn, CSAT, health score).
  • Familiarity with CRM tools and CS platforms (e.g., Salesforce).
  • Previous direct collaboration with the sales team.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience in technology companies (SaaS, Cloud, Infrastructure or Data Center).

title: Quality Engineer - Data Test Engineer (IDMC)
description:
Job Title

Quality Engineer - Data Test Engineer (IDMC)

Company: IBM

Introduction

In this role, you will work in one of our IBM Consulting Client Innovation Centers (Delivery Centers), delivering deep technical and industry expertise to a wide range of public and private sector clients worldwide. Our delivery centers provide locally based skills and technical expertise to drive innovation and adoption of new technology.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Quality Engineer at IBM, your technical skills will directly impact the quality of the software we create. You will help each agile iteration reach the next level, whether the testing is manual, automated, or cognitive, ensuring the best deliverables for our clients and IBM.

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

  • Data Test Engineer with a strong background in Informatica Intelligent Data Management Cloud (IDMC) .
  • Responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and accuracy of data across on‑premise and cloud environments.
  • Validate data migration, transformation, and integration processes using Informatica IDMC.
  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams to guarantee seamless data ingestion from multiple sources—including streaming technologies, cloud platforms, and various data stores—while maintaining the highest standards of data quality and consistency.

Essential Job Functions

  • Design, develop, and execute test plans and test cases for data pipelines and workflows built with Informatica IDMC.
  • Perform data validation and transformation testing to verify completeness, consistency, and accuracy between source and target systems.
  • Develop and maintain automated data validation frameworks using Python, SQL, and IDMC’s built‑in tools and APIs.
  • Implement data quality rules and support continuous integration through CI/CD pipelines.
  • Collaborate with development, operations, and infrastructure teams to identify and resolve data quality issues.
  • Document test plans, test results, and findings in a clear and traceable manner.
  • Support testing activities related to data migration, profiling, analysis, and transformation.
  • Manage defect tracking and reporting, ensuring timely resolution and transparent communication.
  • Contribute to process improvements and testing best practices within an Agile environment.
  • Work closely with cross‑functional teams to support ongoing data governance and compliance initiatives.

Technical Responsibilities

  • IDMC Development and Testing:
    • Understand and create end‑to‑end mappings in IDMC using Filters, Routers, Joiners, and JSON functions.
    • Handle JSON parsing, JSON structures, and JSON strings using the Structure Parser in IDMC.
    • Apply basic Java to write and execute small code snippets when required.
  • Python Coding:
    • Develop functions to read and process data from various file formats.
    • Use libraries such as Pandas for data analysis, manipulation, and validation.
  • Azure Cloud Tools:
    • Utilize Azure Data Factory (ADF), PySpark, or similar technologies to support data integration and transformation testing.
  • Database and SQL Work:
    • Write and optimize SQL queries to validate data between source and target.
    • Ensure data accuracy and completeness within large‑scale datasets.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Solid understanding of software development and delivery in a data‑centric environment.
  • Proficiency with Informatica IDMC and related tools.
  • Strong SQL skills for data validation and transformation.
  • Experience with Python scripting and data libraries (e.g., Pandas).
  • Familiarity with Azure Cloud technologies (ADF, PySpark, or similar).
  • Ability to interpret and draw system and architecture diagrams.
  • Understanding of modern cloud technologies and data governance principles.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
  • Comfortable working collaboratively within an Agile environment.
  • Advance English is a must.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high‑quality work within deadlines.
  • Proactive, collaborative, and curious mindset with a passion for data quality.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and improvement.

Seniority Level

Mid‑Senior level

Employment Type

Full‑time

Job Function

Information Technology

Industries

IT Services and IT Consulting

title: Modélisation de tsunamis déclenchés par des glissements de terrain
description:
Modélisation de tsunamis déclenchés par des glissements de terrain

Cadre scientifique: ANR MEGA

Les glissements sous-marins géants km³) sont présents dans les séries sédimentaires Quaternaire des marges continentales passives. Si leurs âges coïncident avec des fluctuations eustatiques, il est encore difficile d’expliquer comment d’aussi grandes ruptures sont générées sur de faibles pentes (<2˚) en l'absence d'un facteur déclenchant tel qu’un séisme. Des hypothèses proposent le rôle de la dissociation des hydrates de gaz et de l’augmentation des pressions interstitielles. Le projet MEGA explorera ces hypothèses grâce aux premières modélisations reliant la stabilité des hydrates de gaz, les variations de pression/température sur le fond marin et la stabilité des pentes. Il s’appuyera sur une comparaison innovante des systèmes du Nil et de l'Amazone, leurs forçages climatiques différant au cours des cycles glaciaires-interglaciaires. En l’absence de cas historiques de méga glissements, MEGA propose de modéliser leurs conséquences en terme de tsunami sur les zones côtières.

L’objectif est de modéliser et simuler numériquement des tsunamis déclenchés par des glissements sous-marins géants en s'appuyant sur le couplage de deux codes numériques existants: Shaltop pour le glissement de terrain, et Freshkiss3D pour la propagation du tsunami.

La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec des géologues de L'Institut des Sciences de la Terre de Paris (ISTeP) et des mathématicien·nes de l'équipe projet ANGE inria Paris/LJLL.

  • Étude de stratégies de couplage numérique entre Shaltop et Freshkiss3D.
  • Simulation de différents scénarios de glissements de terrain géants sur des zones géographiques précises.
  • Déterminer le rôle de la stratification en température de l'océan

La personne recrutée pourra s'appuyer sur l'approche numérique développée lors d'une précédente collaboration (ANR ALBAMAR) et sur les résultats déjà obtenus dans le cadre de ce projet.

Lieux de travail :

ISTeP, Sorbonne Université, Paris. De courts séjours chez les partenaires du projet sont susceptibles d'avoir lieu (UMR Géoazur, UMR EPOC, Linnaeus University en Suède, Fluminense Federal University et Université d'état de Rio de Janeiro au Brésil).

Collaboration :

La personne recrutée travaillera en étroite collaboration avec Sara Lafuerza (ISTeP), Nina Aguillon (LJLL/ Inria Paris), Jacques Sainte-Marie (Inria Paris) et Bernard Di Martino (Université de Corse).

Responsabilités :

La personne recrutée a la charge de développer le couplage numérique et prendra des initiatives pour communiquer les résultats obtenus aux partenaires du projet.

Pilotage/Management :

La personne recrutée pourra être amener à former un/une étudiante en thèse à la simulation numérique.

Principales activés :

  • Implémenter des scénarios de réaction de l'océan à un glissement sous-marin géant
  • Déterminer les paramètres pertinents
  • Présenter l’avancée des travaux aux partenaires
  • Proposer des améliorations de stratégie numérique

Activités complémentaires :

  • Participer à l'écriture des rapports
  • Initier à l'utilisation du code les partenaires du projet
  • Restauration subventionnée
  • Transports publics remboursés partiellement
  • Congés: 7 semaines de congés annuels + 10 jours de RTT (base temps plein) + possibilité d’autorisations d’absence exceptionnelle (ex : enfants malades, déménagement)
  • Possibilité de télétravailet aménagement du temps de travail
  • Équipements professionnels à disposition (visioconférence, prêts de matériels informatiques, etc.)
  • Prestations sociales, culturelles et sportives (Association de gestion des œuvres sociales d'Inria)

title: Senior Manager, Event Logistics FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
Job Description

The position

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

Key responsibilities

  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects:
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country.
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders.
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which there assets provided by Logistics.
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery.
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities o Movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities.
  • Managingthe entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS).
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un- / loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE.
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM).
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues.
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas.
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required.
  • Manage the established contracts (LSP, FFE- and golf carts provider) and ensure all project milestones, deadlines and KPIs are met.
  • Provide the Logistics Concept of Operations and other project integration management documentation such as Functional Area Operational Plan (FAOP) and Standard Operational Plan (SOP) as required.
  • Attend site / venue visits, workshops, logistics activities, meets and events in which an Event Logistics presence is required (e.g. Team Workshop, Broadcaster Meetings, Partnership Workshops).
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics budget in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Creation and management of the Event Logistics project plan, management (including mitigation) and communication of risks and issues in cooperation with FIFA Zurich Event Logistics.
  • Recruitment of the Logistics team and providing leadership to this team.
  • Prepare and manage a health- & safety plan.
  • Prepare and manage a sustainability and environmental plan related to the Event Logistics Project.
  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management.
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post-tournaments.

Your profile

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience in Major Event Logistics, etc.
  • Knowledge of event logistics planning and event project management processes.
  • Team player, willing to work to tight timelines.
  • Strong analysis, reporting and data skills.
  • Able to work in a fast-paced, multi-level, project-based event environment with emphasis on timelines and delivery.
  • Positive attitude, patience, and persistence.
  • Proven track record in managing complex projects, preferably international sports events.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written).
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written).
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

description:
A GN Resound Produtos Médicos Ltda tem uma trajetória marcada de mais de 150 anos pela inovação e compromisso com a qualidade na área da saúde auditiva. Fundada com a missão de melhorar a qualidade de vida das pessoas com perda auditiva, a GN Resound se destaca como uma multinacional líder mundial em soluções auditivas de alta tecnologia. Sua presença global e atuação em diversos mercados fazem da empresa uma referência, com produtos que atendem às necessidades de clientes em todo o mundo, sempre com foco em qualidade, inovação e excelência no cuidado auditivo.

Resumo da vaga

Estamos contratando um Representante de Vendas para atuar no mercado auditivo com foco em visitação a profissionais da saúde.

Educação

  • Formação em Administração de Empresas, Marketing, Comunicação ou área relacionada.
  • Formação adicional em vendas ou atendimento ao cliente é um diferencial.

Experiência

  • Mínimo de 2-3 anos de experiência em vendas, preferencialmente no setor de dispositivos médicos, tecnologia auditiva ou produtos de saúde.
  • Experiência anterior em vendas B2B é altamente desejável.

Habilidades

  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita em português; conhecimento de inglês é um diferencial.
  • Capacidade de construir e manter relacionamentos sólidos com clientes e distribuidores.
  • Habilidades de negociação e persuasão.
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma autônoma e em equipe.
  • Conhecimento de técnicas de vendas e marketing.
  • Familiaridade com o mercado de dispositivos auditivos e tendências do setor.
  • Compreensão das regulamentações e normativas relacionadas à indústria da saúde no Brasil (SUS).

Competências

  • Orientação para resultados e capacidade de cumprir metas de vendas.
  • Proatividade e capacidade de identificar oportunidades de negócios.
  • Habilidade para resolver problemas e lidar com objeções de forma eficaz.
  • Flexibilidade e adaptabilidade a um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico.

Outros requisitos

  • Disponibilidade para viagens rodoviárias e aéreas em 70% do tempo.
  • Carteira de motorista válida.
  • Residir no Rio de Janeiro será um diferencial, mas não é um requisito essencial.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e executar estratégias de vendas para aumentar a distribuição dos produtos da GN Hearing.
  • Identificar e prospectar novos clientes e oportunidades de negócios.
  • Manter relacionamentos com clientes existentes e garantir sua satisfação.
  • Realizar apresentações de produtos, campanhas e serviços para distribuidores e clientes.
  • Monitorar o mercado e a concorrência para ajustar estratégias de vendas.

Benefícios

  • Salário e Bonificações alinhados ao mercado.
  • Vale Refeição: R$ 880,00 mensais.
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR).
  • TotalPass (benefício para academias).
  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico (Amil).
  • Carro da empresa fornecido.

Se você tem experiência no setor e busca desafios com um pacote de benefícios atrativo, essa é a sua oportunidade! Envie seu currículo e venha fazer parte da nossa equipe.

description:
# Engenheiro de Dados Pleno - RJRio de Janeiro - RJHybrid1 PositionEffective - CLTAnalystFull timeVEM SER NATURAL DA TERRA! Somos o vizinho especialista em produtos frescos e naturais, com qualidade impecável e uma experiência que faz o cliente se sentir em casa. Nossa alma é de feirante: gostamos de conversar, sorrir e oferecer aquele conforto emocional das feiras livres da infância, com um atendimento próximo, humano e cheio de alegria. Todos os dias acordamos com um único objetivo: promover uma vida mais natural – em todos os sentidos. Se você também acredita nesse propósito, vem com a gente! Engenheiro de Dados Pleno Escala: 5x2 (segunda à sexta-feira) / Híbrido Carga horária: 44h semanais Tipo de contrato: CLT Local de Trabalho: Zona Sul/RJ PRINCIPAIS ATIVIDADES DO CARGO: • Criar DAGs de integração via API e/ou manipulação de dados no Airflow em Python com manutenção contínua. • Criar tabelas e processos de ETL em SQL envolvendo delta de camadas junto com o Lakehouse através de procedures no banco. • Criar pipelines e dar manutenção no Azure Data Factory para ingestão de dados no repositório. • Integrar diferentes fontes de dados estruturados e não estruturados; • Garantir a qualidade, segurança e integridade dos dados; • Implementar soluções em ambientes de Big Data e nuvem (AWS, GCP, Azure); REQUISITOS: • Formação superior completa • Experiência em soluções de dados em nuvem (AWS/GCP/Azure) • Experiência em SQL, DML e DDL. • Experiência em linguagem de desenvolvimento Python • Experiência com ferramentas de ETL (ex: Airflow) • Desejável experiência anterior na função atuando na integração de ERP • Desejável experiência anterior na função atuando na integração de CRM • Desejável experiência anterior atuando na integração de sistemas de RH • Desejável experiência com streaming de dados (Kafka, Spark Streaming etc) • Desejável conhecimento em modelagem de dados e Data Warehouses (Snowflake, Redshift etc.) INCLUSÃO E DIVERSIDADE Todas as nossas vagas são abertas para pessoas com deficiência. Valorizamos a diversidade e estamos de braços abertos para todos os talentos, independentemente de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero ou orientação sexual.#LI-Hybrid### Requirements##### StudiesUniversity education### BenefitsConvênio FarmáciaPlano de SaúdePlano OdontológicoAlimentação no LocalWellHubSeguro de Vida### About Hortifruti Natural da TerraSomos o Grupo Hortifruti Natural da Terra, a maior rede varejista de hortifrutigranjeiros do Brasil. Atuamos em um segmento com um jeito diferente de oferecer o frescor das feiras com a praticidade dos grandes mercados. Nosso compromisso é levar sempre até a mesa dos nossos clientes o que a natureza tem de melhor, com frutas, legumes e verduras e, assim, ajudá-los a ter uma vida mais saudável. Somos uma empresa nacional de grande porte, com uma equipe de mais de 5 mil colaboradores e 76 lojas espalhadas por 4 estados (RJ, SP, ES e MG). Nossas lojas recebem cerca de meio milhão de clientes todos os meses. Com operações no modelo omnichannel, as compras podem ser realizadas também pelo site, app, WhatsApp e marketplaces parceiros, atendendo consumidores nas regiões onde estão presentes em até três horas. Transportamos 60 mil toneladas de produtos todos os meses, do campo às bancas em até 24 horas. O Hortifruti Natural da Terra é referência em frutas, legumes, verduras e outros alimentos frescos. Unimos a relação de confiança e proximidade com os produtores ao bom atendimento e produtos de qualidade. Não somos um supermercado, nem feira. Mas o melhor dos dois! Nossa Missão: Promover uma vida mais natural, nos tornando referência e o principal destino de produtos frescos do Brasil. Nossos Valores são: • Jogo aberto e íntegro • Foco em resultado com qualidade • Trabalho em equipe compartilhando o sucesso • Excelência no Atendimento • Jeito simples e alegre de ser • Atitude Responsável Atuamos com profissionalismo, amor e um sorriso estampado no rosto, esse é nosso jeito de ser. Somos mais do que um time, somos uma família! Queremos promover a diversidade em todos os sentidos e todas as equipes. Por isso, queremos o seu olhar também para torná-lo cada vez mais seguro, acolhedor, criativo e inclusivo. Todas as nossas vagas também são abertas para pessoas com deficiência, e toda a diversidade em relação a raças, cores, religiões, gêneros e orientações sexuais é importante e será muito bem-vinda. \_\_

title: ANALISTA FINANCEIRO JUNIOR
description:
Leve Saúde é uma operadora de saúde carioca que nasceu com o propósito de transformar a forma como o cuidado em saúde é oferecido no Brasil. Acreditamos que cuidar vai muito além de oferecer planos — é construir relações, escutar de verdade e estar presente na jornada de cada pessoa. Desde o início, apostamos em um modelo mais próximo, acolhedor e resolutivo. Com equipes próprias e rede integrada, promovemos uma experiência de saúde mais leve, eficiente e centrada no paciente.

O que nos move

  • Tornar o cuidado em saúde mais humano e acessível.
  • Reduzir burocracias e facilitar o acesso a serviços de qualidade.
  • Usar a tecnologia como aliada para melhorar a experiência e os resultados em saúde.

Como fazemos isso

  • Com clínicas próprias, prontas para atender com acolhimento e eficiência.
  • Com uma equipe multidisciplinar que acompanha de perto a jornada dos beneficiários.
  • Com um time interno comprometido com inovação, qualidade e propósito.

Analista de Tesouraria Júnior – Responsável por controle de endividamento e aplicações financeiras

Procuramos alguém analítico, responsável e proativo, que goste de números, tenha atenção a detalhes e queira aprender mais sobre gestão financeira corporativa.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar o controle diário do fluxo de caixa, prevendo entradas e saídas de recursos.
  • Atualizar e acompanhar planilhas de endividamento, registrando prazos, taxas, encargos, garantias e limites contratados.
  • Elaborar e atualizar o mapa consolidado da dívida, destacando vencimentos, indexadores e custos financeiros.
  • Apoiar nas projeções de fluxo de caixa e nas análises de capacidade de pagamento.
  • Controlar e registrar as aplicações financeiras, assegurando o melhor rendimento e a liquidez adequada.
  • Conferir e validar extratos bancários, identificando divergências e garantindo a conciliação diária.
  • Apoiar nos pagamentos e movimentações bancárias, garantindo conformidade com as políticas internas.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e indicadores de tesouraria para suporte à área financeira e diretoria.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior completa ou em andamento em Administração, Economia, Contabilidade ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Excel (fórmulas, tabela dinâmica, gráficos).
  • Desejável vivência com sistemas financeiros e conciliação bancária.
  • Desejável noções de operações financeiras, como empréstimos, aplicações e fluxo de caixa.
  • Perfil organizado, proativo e analítico, com boa comunicação e capacidade de priorização.

Diferencial

  • Experiência prévia em Tesouraria, Contas a Pagar ou Controladoria.
  • Habilidade em automatizar controles financeiros (Excel avançado com programação, Power BI, Python ou Google Sheets).

Informações adicionais

  • ️ Vale Refeição: R$ 42,00/dia (com desconto simbólico de R$ 1,00/mês)
